QuestInfo.name: Condition of Love
QuestInfo.0: Le Tierre is looking awkward after seeing the large diamond ring J is offering for the proposal. There has to be more to this story...
QuestInfo.1: Le Tierre explains that she has been in a relationship with Allen for a long time but she hasn't received a proposal from him in 10 years they have been in a relationship.
QuestInfo.2: You've let Allen know that Le Tierre is tired from waiting.

npc.0: I love him, but I'm just so tired of waiting.
